title: Artillery Strike
description: It added the artillery strike through CBCMW Mod.
body:
# How to use it?
You can summon the artillery strike in Minecraft. After loading the datapack, click the green text or input the following command to get into the interface.
```
/trigger artillery_support (Before v1.1.1)
/function as:run (Starting from v.1.1.1)
```
There are three methods to choose the position of shelling. 
1. Inputting the x and z axis through commands
2. Using head tracking (Choose the block you look at as the center of shelling)
3. Firing at the player directly.

Click the cyan texts to choose. After confirming the position, there will be red warning signs around the shelling area. And soon 10 HE shells will fall from the sky.

# Config
There are detailed annotations in the datapack. But I only recommend to modify the number and types of shells.

# Attention
- Require the permission level of 2 at least.
- DO NOT reload the datapack when the artillery strike is in progress.
- When you are using head tracking, **make sure there are no obstacles forward such as grass, leaves and snow**, because you may receive the position of them.
- The coordinate you input must be within the loading range of chunks, or the shells will generate above the player.
- Please check the coordinate carefully. Don't let the shells land on your position(except method 3)!
- If you find some bugs, you can use /function as:stop and /reload to restart.

# About Multiplayer Game
Starting from version 1.1.1, support for multiplayer games.

# Need
This datapack requires CBC: Modern Warfare mod.
